name: av_ema
description:
Exponential moving average for one stock from Alpha Vantage (EMA) computed on closing prices.
Returns: {"Meta Data", "Technical Analysis: EMA"} keyed by date or timestamp, each with EMA. Alpha Vantage's JSON comes back unchanged, including its "Error Message" or "Information" notes; a network failure gives {"error": ...}.
Inputs (* required): symbol* (ticker); interval (1min, 5min, 15min, 30min, 60min, daily, weekly or monthly; default daily); time_period (bars in the window; default 20 when omitted; the schema says 14).
Use it for trend following with more weight on recent prices; av_sma weights all bars equally. Raw prices: av_stock_daily.
Key: ALPHA_VANTAGE_API_KEY (alpha_vantage.api.key); when unset the 'demo' key is sent, which only serves Alpha Vantage's documentation examples. Free tier: 25 requests/day.
Example: {"symbol": "IBM", "interval": "daily", "time_period": 20}

interval.description: Bar interval: 1min, 5min, 15min, 30min, 60min, daily, weekly or monthly

time_period.description: Number of bars in the indicator window
